title: Launcher
description: Data4Now launcher. Replaces @jupyterlab/launcher-extension:plugin (PRD 8.11, TODO P2-15, docs/decisions.md D-033). This schema re-declares the three affordances core's schema declared, because a disabled plugin's schema is NOT served: measured on 2026-09-05, disabling the core plugin removed File > New Launcher, the Accel Shift L shortcut and the file browser + button, and left the command itself working.
